AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

4. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.

7. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development.

8. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

10. When learning Aircraft Stability, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Stability.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Stability.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Stability.

11. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Entrepreneurship.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Entrepreneurship.

12. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Simulated Flying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cargo Handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
